notes.subject: kumasen-jɔcogo
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV/BSB: den min bɛ o jugu kɛ — nka JPS: 'den min bɛ iya suma kɛ, o de bɛ a fa sɔngoya bɔ ani a ba wele ka taa' — Hebrew kumasen-jɔcogo bɛ sugandi o filananw la

notes.subject: wele ka taa
notes.rationale: ברח kɔrɔnta ye 'ka wili ka bɔ' ye; n'an y'a bayɛlɛmeli 'ka a ba wele ka taa', o ye kalanbaga fɔcogo jɛlen ye

translation: Min bɛ a fa sɔngoya bɔ ani min bɛ a ba wele ka taa, o den bɛ iya suma ani a bonya suma.

tokens.gloss: min bɛ a fa sɔngoya bɔ
ka a ba wele ka taa
ani min bɛ a bonya suma
